blocks.x: This Privacy Policy explains how Theorem JUPEB / CBT App (“Theorem”, “we”, “us” or “our”) handles personal information when students use our mobile app, website, study materials, practice tools and examination features. It should be read together with our Terms of Service.
Depending on the features you use, Theorem may process:

x: Account information, including your email address and the name/avatar you choose for your profile.
Study setup information, including your selected track, university and subject combination, and any request to change a confirmed combination.
Learning and assessment records, including practice/exam attempts, answers submitted, scores, exam history, time taken, accuracy and analytics derived from your activity.
Bookmarks and app preferences associated with your account.

Premium purchase information, including Paystack transaction references, payment status and the date premium access was granted. Payment-card details are handled through the payment provider’s checkout; do not send payment-card details to our support team.

Device and technical information, such as device model, operating-system information, app version, push-notification token, and information needed to maintain sessions, troubleshoot errors and deliver notifications.
Information you send to support, if you contact us.

blocks.x: The exact information processed may vary by app version and features used.

We use information as needed to create and secure accounts; authenticate users; save and retrieve subject combinations, bookmarks and exam history; deliver study notes, past questions and practice questions; grade assessments and calculate analytics; process premium purchases and confirm access; send push notifications when enabled; respond to support requests; prevent account data from appearing to another signed-in user; and operate, maintain and protect the service.

The app retrieves subjects, sections, topics, notes and questions from our content-management service. Some content is restricted to premium sections. Premium access is currently described in the app as a one-time payment of ₦4,000 for nine months. Payment confirmation is checked by our server, and access is granted after confirmation from the payment provider. Content files and images may be delivered through temporary signed links that expire after a limited period.

The implementation notes identify Supabase for authentication and certain account-related data, a separate CMS/API for learning content and exam services, and Paystack for checkout/payment confirmation. Push notifications are delivered through the app’s notification infrastructure. These providers may process information to provide their services. We do not sell personal information as a business practice. We may disclose information where reasonably necessary to operate the service, protect users, comply with law, or respond to lawful requests. Confirm and list any additional providers actually used before publishing.

We use account sessions and server-side access controls to associate data with the relevant student. The app is designed to clear cached account-specific content on sign-out and reset account-specific stores when a different user signs in. No online service can guarantee absolute security, so please protect your sign-in credentials and tell us promptly if you suspect unauthorised access.

If you grant notification permission, the app can register this device to receive notifications sent by the service. You can control operating-system notification permission in your device settings. Signing out is designed to detach the device’s push registration from the account.

We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide the service, maintain relevant account and transaction records, resolve disputes, protect the service and meet applicable legal obligations. The precise retention periods, including for backups and payment records, must be confirmed by the operator and reflected here before publication. Deleting an account does not necessarily erase records that must be retained for legal, security or accounting reasons.

You can sign out through the app. You may request account deletion through the app’s account-deletion feature, subject to successful connectivity and verification. You may also contact theoremacademia@gmail.com to ask about your personal information or applicable privacy rights. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request. The app’s account-deletion flow is designed to remove exam history and push tokens, delete the Supabase user, and cascade to related profile/bookmark records; confirm the live implementation and any retained records before publication.

The supplied implementation notes do not specify a minimum user age or whether the service is directed at children. [OPERATOR: state the intended age group and the process used if a user below the permitted age provides personal information.] Do not publish this policy until this section is completed.

Our service providers may process information in locations outside Nigeria. Before publishing, confirm the locations of the providers and the safeguards relied on for any international transfers, and update this section accordingly.

We may update this policy when the app, our providers or our data practices change. We will post the revised version at [PRIVACY POLICY URL] and update the “Last updated” date. Where required, we will provide additional notice or obtain consent.

Temporary interruptions, maintenance, network failures or provider outages may occur. We may update, modify or discontinue features where reasonably necessary. We will make reasonable efforts to avoid losing submitted answers during supported retry flows, but you should not assume that every unsent response is recoverable after a device or network failure.

Authentication, payment, content delivery and notification features rely on third-party services. Their services may be subject to separate terms and privacy practices. title: Educational Disclaimer
meta: Effective date: [DATE]

blocks.x: Theorem JUPEB / CBT App is intended to support learning and exam preparation through study notes, past questions, practice questions, exam simulations and performance analytics.

sections.h: No official affiliation unless expressly stated

blocks.x: Unless we explicitly state otherwise in writing, Theorem should not be understood to be an official JUPEB examination body, university, admissions authority or government service. The app’s questions, model answers and explanations are study resources and are not a representation that the same questions will appear in an actual examination.

Using the app does not guarantee a particular score, JUPEB result, admission, scholarship or university placement. Results depend on many factors, including a student’s preparation and official examination and admissions decisions.

We aim to provide useful educational material, but errors, omissions, outdated information or differences in interpretation may occur. Students should check important requirements and official examination or admissions information with the relevant authority.

Scores, accuracy, time measurements and subject-performance summaries are learning aids based on activity recorded by the app. They are not official grades or a definitive measure of a student’s ability.
To report an apparent content error, contact [SUPPORT EMAIL] or [SUPPORT WHATSAPP].
